call_goal: Check Ashgrove Telecom's fit; agree 1-3 written test goals, owners and a decision date

transcript.text: So, for the readout: Thursday the nineteenth of November, with Fiona and your VP, Marcus. Does that work?
Yes, the nineteenth works. Put it in for two o'clock our time.
Great, I'll hold that and send the invite after the call.
On sampling, we'd keep everything for the network-fault agent, it's low volume.
That's fine, we'd trace all of it.
And PII. The agent sees customer phone numbers, and we mask those before they hit the logs today.
You'd do the same masking before export, so the spans never carry the raw numbers. I'll send the snippet for that.
Anything else on the technical side before we wrap?
No, I think that covers it. This was really useful, thanks both. Sam, the masking snippet would be great.
